blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.stockLocation` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a new stock location. It sends a request to the
[Create Stock Location](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#stock-locations\_poststocklocations)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the stock location to create.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the stock location.

children.name: address_id
children.description:
The ID of the address to associate with the stock location.
If you provide an `address`, you don't need to provide this property.

children.name: address
children.description:
The address to create or update for the stock location.
If you provide an `address_id`, you don't need
to provide this property.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the stock location.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the stock location.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).
